description_en: Call SaveBatchTaskForUpdatingContactInfoByRegistrantProfileId to update the contact information of one or more domain names by using a registrant profile
description_zh: 调用SaveBatchTaskForUpdatingContactInfoByRegistrantProfileId提交批量域名信息修改任务
name: SaveBatchTaskForUpdatingContactInfoByRegistrantProfileId

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message that is returned if the request fails. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the registrant profile. This ID is automatically generated when you create a registrant profile. You can find registrant profile IDs by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
信息模板编号。
信息模板创建成功后由系统自动生成，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html接口查询信息模板编号
parameters.name: registrant_profile_id

parameters.help_en:
The contact type to modify. Valid values:

registrant: The domain name's registrant.

admin: The administrative contact for the domain name.

billing: The billing contact.

tech: The technical contact
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的联系人类型。取值：
registrant：域名持有者。
admin：管理者。
billing：付费者。
tech：技术者。
parameters.name: contact_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the transfer lock. This parameter is valid only when ContactType is set to registrant. If enabled, this feature prevents the domain name from being transferred for 60 days after the registrant information is modified.

true: Enables the lock, which prevents the domain name from being transferred out.

false: Disables the lock, which allows the domain name to be transferred out.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否添加禁止转出限制，此参数只在ContactType的参数值为registrant的情况下有效，表示持有者修改后是否限制域名60天转出。取值：
false：不转出。
true：转出。

默认值为false。
parameters.name: transfer_out_prohibited

parameters.help_en: An array of domain names to update
parameters.help_zh: 域名。如需传入多个域名，请使用list方式传入
parameters.name: domain_name

RequestId.description_en: A unique ID for the request

TaskNo.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task
